stem.text: A bungee jumper on a platform over a river is attached to an elastic rope that is $20\,\text{m}$ long when unstretched. He falls towards the river and his lowest point is $30\,\text{m}$ below the platform.
The initial gravitational potential energy of the jumper is transferred to other forms during the jump.
Which other forms of energy do the jumper and rope have when the jumper has fallen half-way and when he is at the lowest point of his jump?

A.text: kinetic energy and elastic potential energy; kinetic energy and elastic potential energy

B.text: kinetic energy and elastic potential energy; elastic potential energy only

C.text: kinetic energy only; kinetic energy and elastic potential energy

D.text: kinetic energy only; elastic potential energy only

A: kinetic energy and elastic potential energy
kinetic energy and elastic potential energy
B: kinetic energy and elastic potential energy
C: kinetic energy and elastic potential energy
